verdict.rationale: Drata's Personnel and Devices API endpoints (list/search personnel, list apps for device) plus HR-driven monitoring/connections support tracking of employee status and device compliance, which underpins onboarding/offboarding checklists, and the agent's read-only monitoring of security configs supports access/compliance verification. However, there is no explicit documentation of an HR-sync-triggered onboarding/offboarding checklist workflow or evidence that training completion and access revocation are explicitly tied together as a checklist artifact. Missing for 10: explicit HR system sync documentation, a dedicated onboarding/offboarding checklist feature, and evidence of training-completion tracking tied to leaver access revocation.
